dedupe_keys.name: global energy technology cost of capital projections

description: The FinCoRE researchers publish historical and projected weighted average costs of capital for ten energy technologies across 176 countries. The Zenodo release supplies long and wide CSV layouts and is free under CC BY 4.0. The describing study uses these values to compare future finance assumptions for power-sector pathways. The table can help parameterize investment and levelized-cost calculations in capacity-expansion simulations using model-pypsa-eur or similar tools. A caveat is that country-level projections are scenarios, not project offers, and financing conditions can change with technology risk, policy or exchange rates. The time axis and model assumptions need to remain attached when using a value in another scenario. The own metadata and file names were checked without opening rows or recomputing estimates. The public estimator code has different, noncommercial rights and is assessed separately.
